_comment: Inputs to the deny wall. scripts/render-settings.py expands this into
write verb). Every verb here is spelled from every directory it could
be run from, including the ones the tools are actually installed in:
a rule for `cargo publish` that misses ~/.cargo/bin protects nothing.
The bound is honest: enumeration cannot be complete, so this stops a
cooperative agent reaching a destructive verb, not a hostile one.
The receipt-signing key sits in credential_paths on purpose: a receipt
is only unforgeable while the key is unreadable, so it belongs beside
the SSH keys rather than in a list of its own.
The scheduler verbs are here because a run of the magent profile ran ./install.sh --uninstall against the live machine and turned off every timer, including another project's.
